mainText:
Assistance Off · Simulated presentation, not a model call
The central bet

Test prevention at the pharmacy before promising fewer referrals. Estimates depend on assumptions; the agent never calculates or approves payments.

What would kill this estimate?

Central bet: pharmacy checks prevent 40% of would-be referrals (assumption). If measured prevention is substantially lower, the estimate fails.

Inspect the editable prevention assumption
Fewer items back. A judgement you can reconstruct.

Rule and reason recorded; the agent verifies and advises; a person decides. Existing pricing stays unchanged. Fewer referrals are estimates, not measured savings.
